brief:
Korea and Palestine inaugurated a vocational training facility in Yatta, Hebron, funded by $6.5 million in Korean government support, the Palestine News Network reported. The Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA) partnered with the Palestinian Ministry of Education and Higher Education and the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) to deliver the project.

The school aims to provide technical and vocational training to residents of the southern West Bank area.
